title: How Do Speed Cameras Catch You So Fast? 🎮 #GTA6 #shorts
description:
In open-world games the cops are on you instantly. Real speed cameras are almost that quick, using pure physics. Radar fires radio waves at your car, and the reflection comes back at a slightly different frequency: the Doppler effect, the same reason a siren sounds higher as it comes toward you. Lidar fires short pulses of infrared laser light and times each round trip, taking hundreds of distance readings in about a third of a second; the change in distance gives your speed, and the beam is narrow enough to pick out one car. Average-speed systems read your plate at two points and divide distance by time.

Follow Hidden Mechanics for more everyday engineering, explained in under a minute.
